headline: CSS RulesMap Class Dependencies
what_breaks: src/textual/css/types.py — relies on various CSS types
why: The RulesMap class defines a structure for CSS rules that is essential for rendering styles in the application. Changes to this class may impact how styles are applied across multiple components, particularly those in the DOM and layout modules.
checklist: Review changes to RulesMap structure and types
Check for impacts on src/textual/dom.py and src/textual/layout.py
Ensure consistency with imported CSS types from src/textual/css/types.py
